earliestResponsibleBranch.diagnosis: After enumerator stripping the fragment is 'less the sum of clauses and'. 'less' and 'sum' sat on the arithmetic-connective line of FUNCTION_WORDS; 'clauses' on the structural-lead-in-noun line; 'the', 'of', 'and' are pure grammar; '(a)' and '(b)' are stripped as enumerators. contentWords therefore returned [] and the noise sink took it. The sibling probes 'minus the sum of the foregoing,' and 'plus the product of the foregoing,' surfaced before this mission ONLY because 'foregoing' was partitioned as an adjunct in canary #9 - incidental cover; the operator vocabulary itself was still disposable glue. Proven by the generic control 'plus the difference of' (no adjunct, no digits, no enumerators), which was STRUCTURAL_NOISE before and is UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE after.

newlySurfacedGaps.reasoning: I1 reads '... Consolidated Net Income for such period plus, without duplication ..., the sum of (i) ... (xx) ...'. The ground-truth items anchor the components on either side; the operator 'plus,' sits between them and is anchored by nothing, so at Pass A it is genuinely unrepresented. Pass B composes the formula, so the addition IS represented downstream. This is precisely the class the mission's root invariant makes substantive, and the reviewer-facing cost is one word. The clean repair is to extend the adjacent ground-truth excerpt to include 'plus,' - forbidden in this mission.
